message: No detected input validation: The code only filters files by '.png' extension and checks set_type values, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or image integrity validation on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local filesystem path with no remote fetching, so there are no checksums, signed URLs, or authentication mechanisms present or needed in this code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies `mask.round().long()` to binarize mask values but performs no distribution checks, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset preparation code applies only standard augmentations (flip, rotate, random erase) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code accepts a --weight_path argument for loading saved weights but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading them.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied anywhere in the training code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement beyond separate dataset classes, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads images directly from disk via PIL and passes them through transforms without any shape, range, or schema validation before feeding them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The model outputs a sigmoid-activated tensor but no code checks for NaN values, probability bounds, or threshold sanity on the inference outputs before returning or saving them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a image segmentation pipeline (UNet), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
